fields.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Lucian's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|3.5}} seconds fires an additional shot {{tip|on-attack}} after {{fd|0.25}} seconds, which deals {{as|{{pp|key=%|50 to 60|1;7;13}} AD {{as|physical damage}}}}, increased to {{as|100% AD}} against {{tip|minion|minions}}. He will shoot the same target, else another target within 50 units beyond his {{sti|range|basic attack range}} automatically.
fields.description2: The second shot {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
fields.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Vigilance:}} Whenever '''Lucian''' is {{tip|heal|healed}} or {{tip|shield|shielded}} by an ally, or an enemy champion within 1000 units is {{tip|immobilized}}, his next two shots within 6 seconds are empowered to deal {{as|15|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. He can store up to 4 empowered shots at a time.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
